notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nontoken creature.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding {B}{B} and then five mana in any combination of {B} and/or {R}.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B}, causing you to sacrifice a creature and return Scholar of the Ages and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Burnt Offering and Victimize to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
